chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar, from his father, that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was in...
On a rainy night, he would delay al-maghrib and hasten al-ʿishāʾ, then pray them both together, and he would say: Whoever does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.

key_terms.اللَّيْلَةِ: the night in which the ruling or practice occurred
key_terms.الْمَطِيرَةِ: rainy; describing the circumstance that justified ease
key_terms.جَمِيعًا: together; indicating combining the two prayers
key_terms.فَيُصَلِّيهِمَا: then he would perform the two prayers

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم combine al-maghrib and al-ʿishāʾ on a rainy night?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in a rainy night: he would combine al-maghrib and al-ʿishāʾ for ease. It also links legal ease in worship with the ethical principle of mercy toward people.
